entries.label: MGS3 — Bolshaya Past Base
entries.prompt: Generate exactly ONE wide 16:9 empty fighting-stage background source for CQC Versus Legacy. Faithfully adapt the attached screenshots of Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater (2004 PlayStation 2, NOT Delta) into finely painted HD 2D scenery. Retain location-specific architecture, military era, materials and the original yellow-green wooded lighting. No people, enemies, HUD, writing, logos, watermarks or collage. Continuous level horizontal fighting floor across the lower quarter. This is one whole static source, not fake parallax layers. BOLSHAYA PAST BASE: grounded Soviet forest supply outpost. Follow the earthen concrete-sided zigzag trenches, modest low rectangular green-grey flat-roof supply bunkers, thin wooden supports, stacked military supply boxes, wire perimeter fence and dense broadleaf forest from the captures. Show the helipad clearing at rear right but remove the helicopter entirely (machine has its own asset). Yellowed mossy grass, muddy packed earth, olive drab buildings, overcast hazy golden-green forest canopy. Position a trench and footbridge in the BACKGROUND with an uninterrupted compacted-dirt fighting strip in front. Don't turn this small outpost into Groznyj Grad or a modern base.

notes: Identity, original edition, palette and defining structures checked against the listed game screenshots.
Wide painted combat view includes composition and hidden-detail adaptation; strict 1:1 certification remains pending.
Static source only; not admitted to runtime, no animated layers or collision geometry.
